Stage 7o2d adds an auto row-runner mode:

  PYTHONPATH=gui python -m zap2_gui.app --discord-observation-matrix-run-row <row> --matrix-row-auto

Owner phase:
- selects the row strategy;
- builds nfqws2 if the executable is missing;
- prepares and confirms the default start workflow plan;
- prints one sudo command for the privileged phase.

Sudo phase:
- starts Default workflow if needed;
- runs the guided Discord pre-TLS probe;
- asks the user to open Discord only at MANUAL ACTION.

It still does not launch Discord automatically and does not perform privileged firewall changes unless the user explicitly runs the sudo phase.
